description: This walk takes you between the two popular settlements of Youlgreave and Bakewell in the Peak District. The walk runs for a distance of about 4.5 miles, passing through some beautiful scenery. Starting in Youlgreave you will first head through the stunning Lathkill Dale where there are some fine riverside trails along the River Lathkill. The route then passes through Over Haddon before following quiet lanes and countryside footpaths into Bakewell.
